query: On Flow, set the cell line of my sample liver_rep1 to HepG2, and leave everything else about it as it is.
expected_behavior: Reads `/v2/reference/samples` before editing, and resolves the sample by name to its id with a read rather than guessing an id.

Finds the attribute for 'cell line' in `GET /v2/metadata-attributes` by its `name`, uses its `identifier`, and, because it has options, confirms 'HepG2' is one of them via `GET /v2/metadata-attributes/<identifier>/options` (or that the attribute allows user terms) before writing.
Shows the user the edit before sending it, naming the sample, the attribute and the new value, and stops to wait for an explicit yes; does NOT send the edit without it.
What it says it will send, as a `flow-cli api patch /v2/samples/<id>` body or in words, is only `metadata` with that one attribute, so no other field or attribute would change.
